title: 2.1.3 release readiness: MOSS-Image, Singularity H3 and the Storyboard Flow
description: 2.1.3 ships today (Fabio, 2026-10-27). SWAP: Storyboard (MPI-1231) ships in 2.1.3 in place of Multi-angle; Multi-angle (MPI-1039) stays dev-gated for a later release, possibly LTX 2.5. Done and in: MOSS-Image + follow-ups (MPI-1243/1245/1249/1253), Singularity H3 (MPI-1284), H3 Reference Fast Motion (MPI-1285), H3 reference prompts (MPI-1283). Left before the cut: Cosmo + MCP run Storyboard (the release check moved from MPI-1267), Storyboard gate off + its held note folded, changelog made true to every user-visible change since v2.1.2. The two low-risk AUDIT items (MPI-1302) ride along; high-risk ones wait. Nothing deprecated. LTX 2.5 (MPI-1267) and Draw It In wiring (MPI-1299) are NOT in it. Version cut stays Fabio's call.
